individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured confocal micrograph time-lapse images, not a plot of quantitative data.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel A is a set of micrograph images, not a plot, so error bars are not relevant.

individual-data-points.explanation: The main scatter plots already display the individual measured intensity values (red/green data points) for the representative photoactivation experiment overlaid with the model fit (solid line). The insets show averaged early-time responses as a time-course with error bars, a kinetic-curve summary format for which individual replicate points are not typically required.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Insets represent average early time points responses measured in euchromatin and heterochromatin (red and green data sets, respectively) to emphasize on the initial plateau in heterochromatin.
error-bars-defined.explanation: The insets in panel B display data points with vertical error bars, but the caption does not state what these error bars represent (e.g., SD, SEM, confidence interval) nor the number of replicates/experiments averaged.
